title: Serve Like the King
verse: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
observation: Do you want to be like the King? Serve. Do you want to be great among your peers? Serve. Do you want to make a difference? Serve. The King of all kings came to serve us all by taking our place in payment for salvation. Do we want to walk in the steps of our King? Serve others.
application: Find a way to meet a need today.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the example to live by.
